statement: For every r>=2 and N>=4^(r-1)+2r-1 an explicitly specified ordinary codimension-r local restriction cokernel surjects onto Pic0 of the Fermat quartic
depends_on: C.3ae; tensor product of joint quartic multiplication maps; rank57 certificate; column-pair basepoint certificate; rank-one conormal exterior sequence and rational Chern character
notes: Complex excellent normal strict local rings, regular puncture and regular principal divisor puncture; actual ordinary algebraic equivalence, integral and rational coefficients. Coefficients are explicit products of the four C3ae integer matrices. The initial full-basis bound is3*4^(r-1)+2r-1 and is rigorously sharpened in Step5. Intermediate dimensions and arbitrary-CH preimages are not settled.
